title: Event envelope
description: Wraps every Kafka event. Never contains names, phone numbers, emails, free text or health data (System Design, Inter-service communication).

eventId.description: Unique id. Consumers are idempotent on it.

type.description: Event type, e.g. core.booking.confirmed. Matches the topic's domain prefix.

version.description: Major version of the payload schema.

occurredAt.description: When the event happened, in UTC.

subjectId.description: Pseudonymous id of the user the event is about. Also the Kafka partition key. Null only for platform events with no user.

locale.description: The subject's app language, so consumers can word follow-ups. Null when there is no subject.

traceId.description: W3C trace id (32 lowercase hex characters).

payload.description: Type-specific payload, validated by the schema for type and version.
